about: Bot scorecard limits (docs/BOTS.md, Scorecard). `pnpm bot-report --check` plays `check` and holds it to `checkLimits`; the nightly full suite (`pnpm bot-report --suite=all`, then `--judge`) is held to `limits`. Keys: all, a mode (core.ctf), or a mode and a map (core.ctf/diamond_park). Each measure is the most it may be (failed searches, idle, stuck, think ms) or the least (captures, coverage, going to the goal); bot-report.ts METRICS says which. A worse number fails: raise a limit only with the reason in the commit.
